nodes.description: initialize(address _USDCToken, address _USDTToken, address _treasury) initializer that seeds treasury, tokens, rates, precision and sale window.
adminAddPurchased(address _user, uint256 _amount) onlyOwner adjusts purchased mapping and totalPurchased.
purchaseCLOUDwithERC20(address ERC20token, uint256 ERC20amount) external sale purchase paid with whitelisted stablecoin.
purchaseCLOUDwithETH() external payable sale purchase entry point.
receive() external payable virtual onlySale whenNotPaused entry point for plain ETH transfers.
_purchaseCLOUDwithETH() private routine that books the ETH purchase and forwards funds to treasury.
adminWithdrawERC20(address ERC20token, address _receiver) onlyOwner notOnSale drains an ERC20 balance.
adminWithdraw(address _receiver) onlyOwner notOnSale sends full ETH balance to receiver.
_calcPurchaseAmount(address _token, uint256 _amount) private view converts token amount into CLOUD using rate and precision.
_isPreSale() private view compares block.timestamp with the presale window.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner changes the owner account.
setTimeMOCK(uint256 _start, uint256 _end) unprotected mock setter for the presale window.
clearMOCK() unprotected function that resets totalPurchased.
adminSetEnd() onlyOwner sets PRE_SALE_END to block.timestamp.
uint256 PRE_SALE_START presale start timestamp.
uint256 PRE_SALE_END presale end timestamp.
uint256 PRE_SALE_CLOUD_POOL maximum CLOUD sold during the presale.
address USDCToken whitelisted stablecoin used by supportedCoin.
address USDTToken whitelisted stablecoin used by supportedCoin.
uint256 maxTokensAmount per-address CLOUD cap.
uint256 minTokensAmount per-address CLOUD minimum.
mapping(address => uint256) purchased tracks user allocations.
uint256 totalPurchased running total of sold CLOUD.
mapping(address => uint256) rates price per supported payment token.
mapping(address => uint256) addressToPrecision decimal scaling per token.
address treasury destination of all sale funds.
address _owner privileged account checked by onlyOwner.
msg.sender caller-controlled address used as purchaser and owner candidate.
block.timestamp miner-influenceable value driving sale stage and end time.
IERC20Upgradeable(ERC20token).safeTransferFrom external call pulling user funds to treasury.
payable(treasury).call{value: msg.value} low-level ETH transfer.
_receiver.call{value: address(this).balance} low-level transfer of the whole ETH balance.
totalPurchased += purchaseAmount accumulation guarded by pool cap.
totalPurchased -= purchased[_user] then += _amount reconciliation arithmetic.
(_amount * addressToPrecision[_token] * rates[_token]) / PRECISION multiplication and division.
IERC20Upgradeable(ERC20token).safeTransfer of the full token balance to _receiver.

normalization_plan.reason: The _treasury parameter only exists to initialise the treasury state variable and is fully consumed by initialize.
The _USDCToken parameter is only used inside initialize to set the USDCToken whitelist entry.
The _USDTToken parameter is only used inside initialize to set the USDTToken whitelist entry.
The _user parameter is only an index into the purchased mapping mutated by adminAddPurchased.
The _amount parameter is written directly into purchased[_user] by adminAddPurchased.
The ERC20token parameter is only validated by supportedCoin and consumed by the ERC20 purchase flow.
The ERC20amount parameter feeds directly into _calcPurchaseAmount from the ERC20 purchase function.
The local purchaseAmount in the ERC20 path is immediately accumulated into totalPurchased.
The local purchaseAmount in the ETH path is immediately accumulated into totalPurchased.
The _token parameter of the helper only indexes rates and addressToPrecision inside that helper.
The _amount parameter of the helper is only the multiplicand of the conversion arithmetic.
The _receiver parameter is only the destination address of the owner withdrawal calls.
The _start parameter is only assigned to PRE_SALE_START by the unprotected mock setter.
The _end parameter is only assigned to PRE_SALE_END by the unprotected mock setter.
